gate.notes: A tier replaces the baseline as the default only if every condition holds on the corpus of this plan. live_capable is ModelTier.suitableForLive: the default tier also drives live transcription. max_median_whole_file_rtf is the canKeepUpLive proxy of BenchmarkRun. max_model_residency_mb keeps the model inside a 16 GB Mac's budget next to the speaker models and the app. A result on read speech can at most support a change pending real-Taglish validation; it cannot settle it.
